United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)

title.narrative: The JPO will work under the overall leadership of the Director of the UNESCO Liaison Office in Addis Ababa and direct supervision of the Programme Specialist of the Natural Sciences Sector and in coordination with the colleagues from Education Sector.

description.narrative: Within this context, the JPO will be responsible for: • Contributing to the implementation, monitoring, and evaluation of the STEM Education Programme at the Addis Ababa Liaison Office. • Participating in Meetings organized by AU and ECA to discuss issues on STEM in Africa and articulating UNESCO’s priorities. • Providing support in the design and implementation of projects to enhance participation of girls and women in STEM in Africa. • Drafting of Concept Papers to facilitate mobilization of resources to facilitate effective intervention by UNESCO in STEM Education in Africa. • Raising visibility of STEM Education activities at the UNESCO Addis Liaison Office through social media and any other appropriate channels. • Supporting and contributing to activities to advance youth participation in STEM Education through such as Coding, Robotics, and Innovation and Artificial Intelligence. • Enhancing youth creativity and innovation to emphasize value addition of STEM Education for the African continent and its demographic dividend. • Providing technical backstopping for the natural sciences programme and assisting in the organization of conferences, workshops, and other capacity development workshops at the Addis Office.
